description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Father Mode I (Sazh)] and [Machinst/Support Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Father Mode I (Sazh)

description.name: Machinst/Support Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Machinist and Support abilities deal 5% more damage
